nodes.name: 🔲 Autenticar · Cogna IA
nodes.notes:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
 SUBSTITUIR POR: HTTP Request
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Método:  POST
URL:     {{ $json.baseUrl }}/cogna-ai/user/auth/token
Header:  X-Cogna-AI-Authentication: Basic Base64(email:senha)

Resposta esperada:
{
  "accessToken": "eyJ...",
  "expiresAt": "2026-10-07T..."
}

EXTRAIR: accessToken → usar como Bearer nos próximos nós
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

nodes.name: 🔲 Upload Conteúdo · Cogna IA
nodes.notes:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
 SUBSTITUIR POR: HTTP Request
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Método:  POST
URL:     {{ $json.baseUrl }}/cogna-ai/file/v3/upload
Headers:
  Authorization:    Bearer {{ token }}
  X-Request-Origin: {{ $json.origin }}
Body (multipart):
  file:    [arquivo binário] — opcional
  payload: {
    filterId: "{{ $json.filterId }}",
    vectorizationNeeded: true,
    chunkSize: 3000,
    text: "{{ $json.description }}"  ← alternativa ao arquivo
  }

Resposta esperada:
{ "id": "uuid-do-arquivo" }

REPETIR para cada arquivo em fileKeys[]
COLETAR todos os fileIds em array
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

nodes.name: 🔲 Criar Histórico · Cogna IA
nodes.notes:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
 SUBSTITUIR POR: HTTP Request
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Método:  POST
URL:     {{ $json.baseUrl }}/cogna-ai/history/save/file
Headers:
  Authorization:    Bearer {{ token }}
  X-Request-Origin: {{ $json.origin }}
  Content-Type:     application/json
Body:
  { "filesIds": ["fileId1", "fileId2", ...] }

Resposta esperada:
{ "historyId": "uuid-do-historico" }

EXTRAIR: historyId → vai para o widget GTM
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

nodes.name: 🔲 Aguardar Vetorização
nodes.notes:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
 SUBSTITUIR POR: Wait (8s) +
 HTTP Request de verificação
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Wait: 8 segundos

Verificar:
GET {{ baseUrl }}/cogna-ai/sse/history/{{ historyId }}/file/status
Header: Authorization: Bearer {{ token }}

Aguardar até status = DONE para todos os arquivos.
Para PDFs grandes, aumentar para 15–30s.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
